# World Trade Organization (WTO)

> The WTO is the global institution governing international trade rules, dispute resolution, and multilateral trade negotiations among member nations.

The WTO website serves as the central hub for trade policy information, legal agreements, dispute settlement procedures, and member communications. It provides access to trade statistics, negotiation documents, and capacity-building resources for developing countries.

## Key Topics

- WTO Agreements
- Dispute Settlement
- Ministerial Conferences
- Doha Development Agenda
- Trade Policy Review
- Fisheries Subsidies
- Trade Capacity Building
- General Council
- Appellate Body
- WTO Secretariat
- Member States
- GATT
- Decision-making
- Governance

## About the WTO

- [About the organization](http://www.wto.org/english/thewto_e/thewto_e.htm): WTO organization overview covering structure, governance, and trade rules
- [Director-General: Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala](https://www.wto.org/english/thewto_e/dg_e/dg_e.htm): Biography and profile of WTO Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala
- [Speeches: Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala](https://www.wto.org/english/news_e/spno_e/spno_e.htm): Speeches and statements by Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala

## Trade Topics & Agreements

- [Trade topics gateway](http://www.wto.org/english/tratop_e/tratop_e.htm): Navigation hub for WTO trade topics, agreements, and Doha agenda
- [The Doha Round](https://www.wto.org/english/tratop_e/dda_e/dda_e.htm): Reference guide to Doha Round negotiations and development agenda
- [The WTO Agreement on Fisheries Subsidies](https://www.wto.org/english/res_e/publications_e/fishagree_e.htm): Guide to WTO Agreement on Fisheries Subsidies objectives and benefits
- [WTO Agreement on Fisheries Subsidies enters into force](https://www.wto.org/english/news_e/news25_e/fish_15sep25_e.htm): News on WTO Agreement on Fisheries Subsidies entry into force

## Dispute Settlement & Monitoring

- [Dispute settlement gateway](https://www.wto.org/english/tratop_e/dispu_e/dispu_e.htm): Gateway to WTO dispute settlement process and Appellate Body
- [Implementation and monitoring](https://www.wto.org/english/tratop_e/monitor_e/monitor_e.htm): Trade policy review and implementation monitoring mechanisms

## Resources & Documents

- [Documents and resources gateway](http://www.wto.org/english/res_e/res_e.htm): Gateway to WTO documents, legal texts, reports, and trade statistics
- [Building trade capacity](https://www.wto.org/english/tratop_e/devel_e/build_tr_capa_e.htm): Guide to WTO trade capacity building and technical assistance programs

## Community & Events

- [Community, forums, chat, media newsroom, NGO room](http://www.wto.org/english/forums_e/forums_e.htm): Community engagement hub for forums, media, NGOs, and public events
- [WTO calendar of meetings and events](https://www.wto.org/english/news_e/events_e/events_calendar_view_e.htm): Calendar of WTO meetings, ministerial conferences, and events
- [14th WTO Ministerial Conference news archives](https://www.wto.org/english/news_e/archive_e/mc14_arc_e.htm): News archives for 14th WTO Ministerial Conference

## Support & Contact

- [How to contact the WTO](http://www.wto.org/english/info_e/cont_e.htm): Contact information for WTO divisions and enquiry points

## Optional

- [Website sitemap](http://www.wto.org/english/info_e/site2_e.htm): Website sitemap and navigation structure
- [Website directory](http://www.wto.org/english/info_e/site_e.htm): A-Z index and directory of WTO members and countries
- [Photo gallery](https://www.wto.org/english/res_e/photo_gallery_e/photo_gallery_e.htm): Photo gallery and media library of WTO images
